name: DH2116-R1
summary: DH2116-R1 is Leadshine’s right-hand dexterous hand with 21 degrees of freedom, including 16 active degrees of freedom, and CAN-FD communication. Its listed dimensions are 218 × 119 × 80.5 mm and mass is 850 ±10 g. The exact-model specification gives a maximum five-finger grip force of 94 N, a maximum hook-grip load of 5 kg and IP30 protection.
